notes: Basis GAAP per manifest: government-wide statements mix modified cash (governmental) and accrual (business-type); governmental funds statement is modified cash. Governmental receipts/disbursements/transfers/fund balances from the Total Governmental Funds column (p7, balance sheet p5). Printed Total revenues 31,135,798 includes Bond/loan proceeds 15,310,863, recorded in debt_proceeds (reported_totals includes debt_proceeds); receipts list excludes it. beginning_cash null; ending_cash computed (cash 22,733,083 + county treasurer cash 122,736), equals total governmental funds assets. Business-type from the enterprise funds Total column (p11): no single printed total, so receipts total = operating revenues + interest + grant - loss on disposal (loss on disposal recorded as negative sale of assets receipt); disbursements = operating expenses + interest expense + loan fees. Net position 20,472,858 + 10,031,743 - 7,760,603 - 1,563,502 = 21,180,496. Internal Service Fund (governmental activities) is not in either the governmental funds or enterprise totals and is excluded. Balance sheet = government-wide Statement of Net Position, Total column; component units excluded. General Fund detail uses the General Fund Departments combining schedule (pp23-26, more detailed) instead of the budgetary comparison schedule (pp16-17, not recorded to avoid double counting; it carries the budget column). General Fund department detail uses each department's own function (Building and Zoning general government; Cemetery, Perpetual Care and Senior Center health/welfare; Airport and HandiBus other with review; Library, Pool, Parks, Ballparks, Auditorium culture/recreation), so detail by function does not tie to the statement's mixed 'Public works' (kept as streets/highways) and 'Environment and leisure' (kept as culture/recreation) lines; 'Rural fire' 55,518 is printed under Intergovernmental revenue (p23-24) and recorded as county/other local governments; Health Operating and Uncollectible Tax in general government. Capital outlay object lines in departments assumed equipment purchases. Rental and fees columns: Ambulance treated as ambulance fees, Cemetery/Perpetual Care as cemetery fees. Detail transfers: GF Admin +1,250,193, Council -50,000, Fire -11,691 (net 1,188,502 on statement); Street +236,880 matches Capital Projects -236,880; Grant +50,000; Keno fund transfer out 50,000 has no detail schedule. Transfers in/out in statement (1,537,073 / 348,571) include transfers with enterprise and internal service funds. No hidden transfers found in spending lines. Keno (Other Governmental) fund has no schedule. Business-type funds have no budget schedules. Read pages 1-26 of 26
